text:
```yaml
name: Update mslearn dates

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - dev

jobs:
  merge-dev-into-hubs-recs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up .NET Core
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Merge dev into features/hubs-recs
        run: git checkout features/hubs-recs && git merge dev --no-ff

      - name: Resolve merge conflicts
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "Conflicts detected. Please resolve them manually."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Build project
        run: dotnet build

      - name: Run tests
        run: dotnet test

      - name: Push changes
        run: git push origin features/hubs-recs
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
